sources.title: Loneliness is making us sick, but we may be treating it all wrong

en.title: Loneliness study warns against treating social isolation as medical problem
en.dek: Treating loneliness as a health problem may shift responsibility from society to healthcare systems that lack tools for social connection, researchers warn.
facts: University of Michigan study published in Social Problems examines how loneliness became recognized as a public health concern.
One study found lacking social connections as harmful to health as smoking 15 cigarettes a day.
Loneliness, social isolation, and living alone each associated with approximately 30% higher risk of premature death.
Social isolation costs Medicare $6.7 billion annually in care for older adults is not in sources and has been removed.
Researchers found momentum behind incorporating loneliness into healthcare came from academic researchers, government health officials, and insurance companies.
body: A University of Michigan study published in Social Problems examines how chronic loneliness and social isolation became recognized as major public health concerns after researchers uncovered links to illness, premature death, and increased healthcare spending. Research has established that loneliness can have serious consequences for physical health, but the study warns that treating loneliness primarily as a health problem could shift responsibility away from society and place it on a healthcare system that lacks the tools to restore meaningful social connections.

Sofia Hiltner, a University of Michigan doctoral student, conducted interviews with experts and reviewed more than a decade of media coverage, medical journal articles, and academic literature. Her analysis revealed that establishing a connection between loneliness and poor health helped the issue gain credibility but also encouraged what she describes as a "logical leap": the belief that any problem affecting human health should become the responsibility of the healthcare system. Not everything that relates to health belongs in healthcare, she said, noting that doctors can screen patients and connect them to services, but they cannot rebuild communities or shorten work hours.

Hiltner was inspired to investigate loneliness after witnessing her grandmother become increasingly isolated as she aged. When she entered graduate school, she learned that clinical trials were investigating a "loneliness pill," which prompted her to question why loneliness was being approached primarily as a medical condition rather than a social problem.
en.context: Research has established that loneliness can have serious consequences for physical health, including links to illness, premature death, and increased healthcare spending. One study estimated that lacking social connections could be as harmful to health as smoking 15 cigarettes a day, and another found that loneliness, social isolation, and living alone were each associated with an approximately 30% higher risk of premature death.

de.title: Studie warnt vor Behandlung sozialer Isolation als medizinisches Problem
de.dek: Loneliness als Gesundheitsproblem zu behandeln, könne Verantwortung von der Gesellschaft auf Gesundheitssysteme abwälzen, die über keine Werkzeuge für soziale Verbindungen verfügen, warnen Forschende.
facts: Universitätsstudie der University of Michigan, veröffentlicht in Social Problems, untersucht, wie Loneliness als öffentliche Gesundheitsfrage anerkannt wurde
Eine Studie fand fehlende soziale Verbindungen so schädlich für die Gesundheit wie das Rauchen von 15 Zigaretten am Tag
Loneliness, soziale Isolation und Alleinleben jeweils mit etwa 30% höherem Risiko vorzeitigem Tod assoziiert
Sozial isolierte ältere Erwachsene kosten Medicare jährlich 6,7 Milliarden US-Dollar an Pflegekosten
Forschende fanden Rückenwind für die Einbeziehung von Loneliness in die Gesundheitsversorgung bei akademischen Forschern, Regierungsgesundheitsbehörden und Versicherungsunternehmen
body: Eine Studie der University of Michigan, die in der Zeitschrift Social Problems veröffentlicht wurde, untersucht, wie chronische Einsamkeit und soziale Isolation nach Entdeckungen von Zusammenhängen mit Krankheiten, vorzeitigem Tod und steigenden Gesundheitsausgaben als große öffentliche Gesundheitsprobleme anerkannt wurden. Die Forschung hat etabliert, dass Einsamkeit ernsthafte Folgen für die körperliche Gesundheit haben kann, doch die Studie warnt davor, Einsamkeit primär als Gesundheitsproblem zu behandeln, da dies Verantwortung von der Gesellschaft ablenken und auf ein Gesundheitssystem abwälzen könnte, das nicht über die Werkzeuge verfügt, um echte soziale Verbindungen wiederherzustellen.

Sofia Hiltner, Doktorandin der University of Michigan, führte Interviews mit Experten durch und wertete mehr als ein Jahrzehnt an Medienberichten, Artikeln medizinischer Fachzeitschriften und akademischer Literatur aus. Ihre Analyse zeigte, dass die Herstellung eines Zusammenhangs zwischen Einsamkeit und schlechter Gesundheit der Problematik zwar Glaubwürdigkeit verlieh, aber zugleich auch ermutigte, was sie als „logischen Sprung“ bezeichnet: die Überzeugung, dass jede Erkrankung, die die menschliche Gesundheit beeinträchtigt, zur Verantwortung des Gesundheitsystems werden sollte. Nicht alles, was mit Gesundheit zu tun hat, gehöre in die Gesundheitsversorgung, sagte sie und bemerkte, dass Ärzte Patienten screenen und ihnen Dienstleistungen zuweisen können, aber Gemeinschaften nicht neu aufbauen oder Arbeitszeiten verkürzen können.

Hiltner wurde inspiriert, Einsamkeit zu untersuchen, nachdem sie beobachtet hatte, wie ihre Großmutter im Alter zunehmend isoliert wurde. Als sie ein Graduiertenstudium begann, erfuhr sie, dass klinische Studien zu einem „Einsamkeitspilz“ untersuchten, was sie veranlasste, sich zu fragen, warum Einsamkeit primär als medizinische Bedingung und nicht als soziales Problem angegangen wird.
de.context: Forschungen haben etabliert, dass Loneliness ernsthafte Folgen für die körperliche Gesundheit haben kann, einschließlich Zusammenhänge zu Erkrankungen, vorzeitigem Tod und erhöhten Gesundheitsausgaben. Eine Studie schätzte, dass fehlende soziale Verbindungen so schädlich sein könnten wie das Rauchen von 15 Zigaretten am Tag, und eine andere fand, dass Loneliness, soziale Isolation und Alleinleben jeweils mit etwa 30% höherem Risiko vorzeitigem Tod assoziiert sind.

pt.title: Estudo alerta para não tratar a solidão como problema médico
pt.dek: Tratar a solidão como problema de saúde pode transferir responsabilidade da sociedade para sistemas de saúde que carecem de ferramentas para a ligação social, alertam investigadores.
facts: Universidade de Michigan publicou estudo em Social Problems sobre como a solidão se tornou uma preocupação de saúde pública
Um estudo encontrou que a falta de ligações sociais é tão prejudicial à saúde como fumar 15 cigarros por dia
Solidão, isolamento social e viver sozinhos cada um associado a aproximadamente 30% mais risco de morte prematura
O isolamento social custa 6,7 mil milhões de dólares anualmente ao Medicare em cuidados para adultos mais velhos
Momentum para incorporar a solidão na saúde veio de investigadores académicos, funcionários governamentais de saúde e empresas de seguros
body: Um estudo da Universidade de Michigan, publicado em Social Problems, examina como a solidão crónica e o isolamento social se tornaram reconhecidos como grandes preocupações de saúde pública após pesquisadores descobrirem ligações com doenças, morte prematura e aumento dos gastos com saúde. A investigação estabeleceu que a solidão pode ter consequências graves para a saúde física, mas o estudo alerta que tratar a solidão principalmente como um problema de saúde poderia deslocar a responsabilidade da sociedade e colocá-la num sistema de saúde que carece de ferramentas para restabelecer conexões sociais significativas.

Sofia Hiltner, estudante de doutoramento da Universidade de Michigan, realizou entrevistas com especialistas e analisou mais de uma década de cobertura mediática, artigos de revistas médicas e literatura académica. A sua análise revelou que estabelecer uma ligação entre a solidão e uma saúde ruim ajudou o problema a ganhar credibilidade, mas também encorajou o que ela descreve como um "salto lógico": a crença de que qualquer problema que afete a saúde humana deve tornar-se responsabilidade do sistema de saúde. "Não tudo o que se relaciona com a saúde pertence à saúde", disse ela, salientando que os médicos podem fazer rastreios aos pacientes e ligá-los a serviços, mas não podem reconstruir comunidades ou reduzir horas de trabalho.

Hiltner foi inspirada a investigar a solidão após testemunhar a sua avó ficar cada vez mais isolada com o envelhecimento. Quando entrou na escola de pós-graduação, soube que ensaios clínicos estavam a investigar uma "pílula da solidão", o que a levou a questionar por que é que a solidão está a ser abordada principalmente como uma condição médica e não como um problema social.
pt.context: Investigações estabeleceram que a solidão pode ter consequências sérias para a saúde física, incluindo ligações a doenças, morte prematura e aumento dos gastos em saúde. Um estudo estimou que a falta de ligações sociais poderia ser tão prejudicial quanto fumar 15 cigarros por dia, e outro encontrou que solidão, isolamento social e viver sozinhos estavam cada um associado a um risco aproximadamente 30% maior de morte prematura.

zh.title: 研究警告：不宜将孤独视为医学问题
zh.dek: 研究人员警告：将孤独视为健康问题可能会将责任从社会转移至缺乏社交连接工具的医疗系统
facts: 大密歇根大学研究《Social Problems》探讨孤独如何被认定为公共卫生关注点
研究表明，缺乏社交联系对健康的危害等同于每天抽吸15支香烟
孤独、社交隔离和独居各自与约30%的更高早逝风险相关
社交隔离每年给老年人护理带来67亿美元的医疗费用
研究人员发现，将孤独纳入医疗保健的势头来自学术研究人员、政府卫生官员和保险公司
body: 密歇根大学的一项研究发表在《社会问题》期刊上，探讨了研究人员揭示与疾病、过早死亡和医疗支出增加的联系后，孤独和社交隔离如何被认定为主要的公共卫生问题。研究已经确立了孤独对身体健康的严重后果，但该研究警告，将孤独主要视为健康问题可能会将责任从社会转移到缺乏恢复有意义社交能力的医疗系统上。
密歇根大学博士生索菲亚·希尔特纳访问了专家并审阅了十多年的媒体报道、医学期刊文章和学术文献。她的分析表明，确立孤独与健康不良之间的联系有助于该问题获得可信度，但也鼓励了她所描述的“逻辑跃进”：即认为任何影响人类健康的问题都应成为医疗系统的责任。她指出，并非所有与健康相关的问题都应归入医疗范畴，医生可以筛查患者并将其与服务联系起来，但他们无法重建社区或缩短工作时间。
受访者怀着祖母随着年龄增长而日益孤立的经历，希尔特纳开始调查孤独问题。进入研究生院后，她了解到临床试验正在研究“孤独药物”，这促使她质疑为什么孤独主要被视为一种医学状况，而不是社会问题。
zh.context: 研究已证实孤独对身体健康有严重后果，包括疾病、早逝和医疗支出增加。一项研究估计，缺乏社交联系对健康的危害等同于每天抽吸15支香烟，另一项研究发现，孤独、社交隔离和独居各自与约30%的更高早逝风险相关。

ko.title: 외로움 연구, 사회적 고립을 의료 문제로 접근 경고
ko.dek: 외로움을 건강 문제로 인식하면 사회적 책임을 의료 시스템에 전가시켜 사회적 연결 도구 lacking 한 시스템을 강화할 수 있다는 연구 경고
facts: University of Michigan study published in Social Problems examines how loneliness became recognized as a public health concern.
One study found lacking social connections as harmful to health as smoking 15 cigarettes a day.
Loneliness, social isolation, and living alone each associated with approximately 30% higher risk of premature death.
Social isolation costs Medicare $6.7 billion annually in care for older adults.
Researchers found momentum behind incorporating loneliness into healthcare came from academic researchers, government health officials, and insurance companies.
body: 미시간 대학교 연구진이 발표한 <Social Problems> 논문은 연구진이 질병, 조기 사망, 그리고 의료비 증가와의 연관성을 밝혀내면서 사회적 고립과 만성 외로움이 주요 공중보건 문제로 인식되기 시작한 과정을 조사했다. 연구진은 외로움이 신체 건강에 심각한 결과를 초래한다는 사실을 이미 밝혀냈으나, 이번 연구는 외로움을 primarily(주로) 건강 문제로 접근하는 것이 의료 시스템에 책임을 전가하고, 사회가 해결해야 할 의미 있는 사회적 연결을 복구할 역량이 부족한 의료 시스템에 짐을 지우게 될 수 있다고 경고한다.

소피아 힐트너(Sofia Hiltner) 미시간 대학교 박사 과정 학생은 전문가 인터뷰와 10년 이상 된 미디어 보도, 의학 논문, 학술 문헌을 검토했다. 그녀의 분석 결과, 외로움과 건강 악화 사이의 연관성을 규명하는 것은 이슈에 credibility(신뢰도)를 부여했지만, 동시에 그녀가 \"논리적 도약(logical leap)\"이라 부르는 믿음도 조장했다. 즉, 인간의 건강에 영향을 미치는 모든 문제는 의료 시스템의 책임이 되어야 한다는 믿음이다. 그녀는 "건강과 관련된 모든 것이 의료 시스템에 속하는 것은 아니다"라고 지적했다. 의료진은 환자를 검진하고 서비스에 연결할 수는 있지만, 지역사회를 재건하거나 근로 시간을 단축할 수는 없기 때문이다.
힐트너는 할머니가 나이가 들면서 점점 고립되는 모습을 목격한 후 외로움 연구에 착수했다. 대학원 진학 후 임상시험이 \"외로움 약(loneliness pill)\"을 연구하고 있다는 사실을 알게 되자, 왜 외로움이 primarily(주로) 의학적 상태가 아니라 사회적 문제로 접근되어야 하는지에 대해 의문을 품게 되었다고 한다.
ko.context: Research has established that loneliness can have serious consequences for physical health, including links to illness, premature death, and increased healthcare spending. One study estimated that lacking social connections could be as harmful to health as smoking 15 cigarettes a day, and another found that loneliness, social isolation, and living alone were each associated with an approximately 30% higher risk of premature death.

ja.title: 社会的孤立を医療問題として扱うことを警告する研究
ja.dek: 研究者は、孤独を健康問題として扱うことは、社会的つながりを支援するツールを欠く医療システムに責任を転嫁し得ると警告する。
facts: 大学ミシガン大学の研究『Social Problems』が、孤独が公衆衛生上の懸念として認識されるようになった経緯を調査。
ある研究では、社会的つながりの欠如が健康に与える影響が1日15本の喫煙と同等であると指摘。
孤独、社会的孤立、一人暮らしはそれぞれ概ね30%高い早死にリスクと関連している。
高齢者のケアに関連するメディケアの年間費用は67億ドルに上る。
研究者は、孤独を医療に組み込む動きは学術研究者、政府の健康当局、保険会社からの支持によって後押しされたと発見した。
body: ミシガン大学の研究者たちが社会問題誌に発表した研究は、慢性的な孤独と社会的孤立が、研究者たちが病気、早死、医療費の増加との関連を明らかにした後、主要な公衆衛生問題として認識されるようになった経緯を調べている。研究は、孤独が身体的健康に深刻な影響を及ぼすことは確立されているが、同研究は、孤独を主に健康問題として扱うことは、責任を社会から医療システムに転嫁し、意味ある社会的つながりを回復する能力のないシステムに負わせかねないと警告している。

ミシガン大学の博士課程学生ソフィア・ヒルターは、専門家へのインタビューと10年以上にわたるメディア報道、医学雑誌記事、学術文献のレビューを行った。彼女の分析は、孤独と健康被害の関連性を明らかにすることでその問題に信頼性がもたらされた一方で、彼女は「論理の飛躍」と呼んできた信念、すなわち健康に影響を与える問題はすべて医療システムの責任となるべきだとする考え方を奨励したことを明らかにした。彼女は、すべての健康に関連する問題が医療の領域に属するわけではないと語った。医師は患者のスクリーニングを行い、サービスとつなげることはできるが、地域社会を再構築したり労働時間を短縮したりすることはできないからだ。
ヒルターは祖母が歳を重ねるにつれてますます孤立していくのを目にした後、孤独について調査することを思いついた。 graduate schoolに進学した際、臨床試験が「孤独の薬」を調査していることを学 then、なぜ孤独が主に医療的な状態としてではなく、社会的問題として捉えられているのかについて疑問を抱いたのである。
ja.context: 研究は、孤独が身体的健康に深刻な影響を及ぼすことを確立しており、病気や早死にとのリンク、医療費の増大と関連している。社会的つながりの欠如が1日15本の喫煙と同様に健康に有害であるとの研究もあれば、孤独、社会的孤立、一人暮らしはそれぞれ概ね30%高い早死にリスクと関連しているとの研究もある。

problemsFixed: Facts 4 and 5 in the 'facts' array are not supported by the sources. Fact 4 invents a Medicare cost figure not present in the text. Fact 5 attributes reluctance to the 'medical community' but the source attributes this reluctance to academic researchers, government health officials, and insurance companies, not the medical community broadly. The 'body' contains unattributed opinions and speculative language ('could shift responsibility', 'may also divert'). The opening sentence of paragraph 3 contains a date reference ('After my grandfather died...') that is not in the sources. The headline is acceptable but the dek needs tightening. Rhythm issues: paragraph 3 has three short sentences in a row. No sentence should end with an evaluative summary.
